items.text: Consolidated Financial Statements During the year, the Group has reported an improvement in its assets base which increased to 1,437,310 million as at December 31, 2025, from PKR 1,378,396 million as at December 31, 2024. The shareholders’ equity was PKR 100,261 million as of the year end. The Group reported a profit after tax of PKR 10,391 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to PKR 13,138 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. Total income has decreased by 28% over the last year mainly on account of decrease on return of investments during the year. The administrative and other expenses have increased by 25% over the last year. (PKR in ‘000’) Profit before taxat
